summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K confirming that on September 9, 2026, the public deed of capital reduction was registered with the Commercial Registry of Santander, following the executive committee's September 1 decision. The reduction totals EUR 231,341,569.50 via cancellation of 462,683,139 own shares, roughly 3.08% of share capital, lowering capital to EUR 7,278,241,400.50 across 14,556,482,801 shares of EUR 0.50 nominal. Since 2021, cumulative buyback-related reductions reach EUR 1,557,002,469.50 and 3,114,004,939 shares, about 18%. No advisor named; watch future buyback tranches and EPS accretion.
